description.value: House of Gato is a small, boutique pastry shop in downtown Fernie specializing in French-style pastries, artisanal breads, and seasonal cakes. The shop sources primarily Canadian ingredients, actively supporting local farmers and artisans. A touring cyclist stopping here will find croissants, sourdough, savory pastries, and hot drinks in a compact downtown location.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website loaded successfully and confirms House of Gato as a real, operating boutique pastry shop at 601 C 2nd Avenue, Fernie BC, corroborating the OSM address. No bike-specific amenities (parking, water refill, rack, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so all such fields remain null. One notable discrepancy: OSM lists closing time as 13:00, but the website states 10am–2pm (14:00) on Thursday–Saturday.
concerns: OSM closing time (13:00) conflicts with website (2pm / 14:00) on Thursday–Saturday — OSM hours appear outdated.
